nodes.description: Defective NHEJ leaves DNA double-strand breaks unrepaired, causing hypersensitivity to DSB-inducing agents, increased cell death, and genomic instability. Impaired proliferation and survival of progenitor cells during development is proposed to drive the prenatal-onset growth failure and primary microcephaly.
